# Draft:Linn Warme

----
Linn Warme (born 1988) is a Swedish illustrator and surface pattern designer based in Västerås, Sweden. She is known for her nature-inspired illustrations and textile designs, which have been featured in editorial work, licensing projects, and international exhibitions.
Education and career
Linn Warme studied textile art at HDK-Valand – Academy of Art and Design in Gothenburg and later completed a master’s degree in textile design at the Swedish School of Textiles in Borås. She has worked in-house for Swedish fashion brands including Gudrun Sjödén and Lindex.
She later transitioned to working full-time as a freelance illustrator and designer. Her designs have been licensed by clients such as Moda Fabrics and featured by publications and companies including The Architectural Review and Harper & Blake. In 2020, she received a grant from the Swedish Arts Grants Committee (Konstnärsnämnden).
Style and work
Warme's work often explores themes from nature, including flora, fauna, and forest scenes. She combines traditional illustration with digital tools to create repeat patterns and surface designs.
Exhibitions and recognition
In 2018, Warme was one of the winners of the international design competition Printeriors, organized by FESPA. In 2017, she was selected for the Ung Svensk Form (Young Swedish Design) exhibition, where she received a scholarship from the Japanese company Askul. She was also awarded Västerås City's Cultural Scholarship in 2014.
Selected exhibitions
* Återvändarna, Västerås Konsthall, 2020
* Ung Svensk Form, Sweden and Japan, 2017
* FESPA Printeriors, Berlin, 2018
